Bug_Title: BIT: Bitwise add of signed byte value (BIT_ADD_OF_SIGNED_BYTE)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the line where the bitwise addition is performed inside the loop. When a byte value is added to an int value in Java, the byte value is sign-extended to an int value before the addition. This causes the incorrect result when the byte value is negative.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered in the assertEquals method when the expected result (0xffffffff) does not match the actual result returned by the showBug method. This happens because the showBug method performs a bitwise addition of signed byte values, which results in an incorrect result when the byte value is negative.
